title: Residential Lawns
summary: Front and back gardens replaced with an evergreen lawn that never needs watering.
body: We lift the existing lawn or surface, prepare and compact a stable, free-draining base, and install turf matched to how the space is used — from quiet front gardens to busy family lawns.
points: Existing lawn removal and base preparation
Turf selected for look and foot traffic
Clean edging against paving, beds and walls

title: Pool Surrounds
summary: A soft, clean edge around the pool with no mud tracked into the water.
body: Turf around pools stays green through splash and sun, and the free-draining base lets water run through rather than pool at the coping.

title: Putting Greens
summary: Backyard and estate putting greens, scoped to your space.
body: Putting surfaces need a firmer, flatter base than a lawn. We scope contours, cup positions and surrounds on site before quoting.
points: Base prepared for a true roll

title: Estates
summary: Common areas, verges and clubhouse surrounds that stay uniform all year.
body: For estates and HOAs, turf removes irrigation from the maintenance budget and keeps shared spaces consistent across seasons.

title: Commercial Properties
summary: Office parks, frontages and hospitality spaces with no irrigation overhead.
body: A permanently green frontage with predictable upkeep. We scope, supply and install with our own team — suited to tenders that need a single accountable contractor.

title: Schools
summary: Hard-wearing play and assembly areas that stay usable after rain.
body: Turf gives schools a clean, usable surface through wet and dry seasons, with drainage that clears standing water after storms.
points: Installation planned around the school calendar

title: Restaurants
summary: Outdoor seating and beer-garden areas that look good every service.
body: A consistent green setting for outdoor seating and function areas, without watering schedules or worn patches.

title: Sports Facilities
summary: Training and multi-use surfaces scoped to the sport and the site.
body: Sports surfaces are scoped individually. We assess the site, base and intended use before recommending a system.

title: Maintenance & Refresh
summary: Restore existing artificial turf — cleaning, brushing, infill and repairs.
body: Existing turf that has flattened, collected debris or lifted at the seams can often be restored rather than replaced. We assess it on site and tell you straight.
